item.question: How does cross-validation reveal differences in strategy effectiveness for RL agents trained on different days?
item.answer: Cross-validation shows that while agents maintain positive gains when tested on sequential data regardless of day differences from training, they struggle with day-specific strategies. In contrast, testing with jumps requires matching training methods for effective strategy implementation.
